name: sunhestia-site
description: SunHestia — residential solar PV + battery storage for European homeowners (GEO experiment site, W1 baseline)

scripts.check: node -e "try{require.resolve('@astrojs/check');require.resolve('typescript')}catch(e){console.error('site: 缺 @astrojs/check / typescript —— 先 npm install,不得跳过静态检查');process.exit(1)}" && astro check
scripts.deploy: wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name sunhestia --branch main
